metadata.author: Yoto
metadata.description:
Grab your apron - it’s time to get baking! This 25-minute yummy Banana Pancake recipe is perfect for budding bakers, with simple instructions that kids can follow at their own pace. Prepare for tummy-rumbling food jokes, snack-tastic music, washing up tunes and more!  Please note: this activity requires adult supervision and the use of a stove.  

Narrated by The Great American Baking Show winner Vallery Lomas. This recipe takes around 25 minutes to complete, from preparing to bake to digging in! Go through the steps at your own pace.

Ingredients:  
All-purpose flour 
Baking powder 
Two bananas 
Two eggs 
Milk  

Discover:  Listen to 1 recipe from the Baking with Yoto pack for free! 
Full Pack: The full pack has 5 scrumptious recipes.   
Available: Until the end of March.
